uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: While this Pokémon's HP is at half or less; reduces move cooldowns by 20% of the max cooldown for future move uses.
The user slashes their claws at opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to them. This Pokémon has no boosted attack.
No English description available in Unite-DB JSON.
Empowers the next basic attack for up to 5s with extra damage, the user bites with its viciously sharp fangs dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon by 35% for 1.5s.

The user cycles between 3 Fangs for up to 5s. When a Fang is chosen; empowers the next basic attack with extra damage, and a variety of effects based on the chosen Fang for up to 5s. After landing the empowered basic attack, the user's attack speed increases by 140% for 5s or 3 hits. After hitting an opposing Pokémon with a Fang, a mark is left for 5s. There are three marks, one for each Fang, the more marks there are the more damage Big Jaw Bite will deal, as well as refreshing the duration of the effects from the Fangs. Future uses of this move will cycle starting from the last effect chosen. Destructive Fangs (Yellow): deals increased damage and reduces the defense of opposing Pokémon by 30% for 5s when landing the empowered basic attack. Gluttonous Fangs (Red): after landing the empowered basic attack, for the next 5s basic attacks restore extra HP once per attack. Clamping Fangs (Purple): after landing the empowered basic attack; slows opposing Pokémon by 80% for 3s, decaying by 15% every 0.25s down to 20%.
Increases the damage of this move.
The user dashes in the designated direction, raking opposing Pokémon with sharp claws dealing damage and stunning them for 0.6s.

The user becomes Hindrance Resistant, gaining a shield for 3s, and begins storming in the designated direction for up to 3s. This move can be manually cancelled, or ended by colliding with a wall. This move will pierce through wild Pokémon, but stops when colliding with Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and stunning or throwing them depending on how far the user travelled. There are 7 damage thresholds based on how far the user travelled, each one increasing the damage of the point blank hit by 10%. At point blank range the move will stun opposing Pokémon for 0.2s. Travelling a short distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 0.45s. Travelling a medium distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 0.67s. Travelling a long distance will cause the move to throw opposing Pokémon for 1s.
The point blank hit will now throw opposing Pokémon for 0.45s.

The user becomes Unstoppable while letting out an intimidating growl, reducing move cooldowns by 40% of the remaining cooldown, and reduces move cooldowns by 40% of the max cooldown for future move uses while this move is active for up to 15s. Additionally the user's tenacity is increased by 30% for 15s. When this move is used again, the user becomes Unstoppable and charges at the designated Pokémon from the opposing team and sinks their teeth into them, dealing damage. The amount of damage dealt is based on the number of Fang marks applied by Crunch.
Buffs: 50% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, 20% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6
